Name: Top Surgery Scars On Bachelors (TSSOB)
Author: OftenUno
Description:
I have edited all the bachelors to have a variety of top surgery scars, per request of a friend! However, this is only relevant on the beach, and also Alex's workout scene. I also don't.. have access to the beach, so I can't promise this looks good, or even works at all. (If anyone would like to reply to this and tell me how it looks I would be VERY grateful T_T)

As Sebastian and Shane wear shirts to the beach, I've put them in binders. This includes their portraits, my own first foray into detailed pixel art, and an easter egg.

Download, unzip, add to mods folder.
There is a readme for the easter egg, but it is not necessary to go digging about in the code.

Please enjoy! Feel free to comment anything, critiques, colour changes, requests, or just to tell me that it works *~*

Now updated to its 1.1 version. Unsure if I uploaded it broken or if it broke with the content patcher update. I am still learning how these things work!!
